records.jp: あれは……教会……？
records.en_original: A church...?
records.en_auxiliary: A church...?
records.en: A church...?

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん？　何か思い出せそう？
records.en_original: Hiori? You remember anything?
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori? You remember anything?
records.en: Hiori-san? Does anything seem familiar?

records.jp: うん……。<CR>私はここで……誰かと戦ってた
records.en_original: Yeah... I fought someone here once.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... I fought someone here once.
records.en: Yeah...<CR>I fought someone here.

records.jp: ってことは、今度はリフレクターの頃の記憶かな？
records.en_original: This must be a memory from her time as a Reflector then.
records.en_auxiliary: This must be a memory from her time as a Reflector then.
records.en: Then this must be a memory from your time as a Reflector.

records.jp: そう、ここで私は……あの子から――
records.en_original: That's right... This is where—
records.en_auxiliary: That's right... This is where—
records.en: That's right. This is where I... from that girl—

records.jp: ……ふふふっ
records.en_original: ...Hehehe.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hehehe.
records.en: ...Hehehe.

records.jp: なんであなたは、<CR>いつまでも私たちの邪魔をするの！？
records.en_original: Why are you always getting in our way?!
records.en_auxiliary: Why are you always getting in our way?!
records.en: Why do you insist on<CR>getting in our way?!

records.jp: それはもちろん、楽しいからですよ～？
records.en_original: Because it's so much fun, of course!
records.en_auxiliary: Because it's so much fun, of course!
records.en: Because it's so much fun, of course!

records.jp: あなたたち姉妹は、<CR>強い、強い想いを抱えてますから
records.en_original: You sisters have some very powerful emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: You sisters have some very powerful emotions.
records.en: You sisters carry<CR>such strong, powerful feelings.

records.jp: 高く積みあがったものほど、<CR>崩れた時に良い音を出すんですよね～♪
records.en_original: All the more satisfying when I crush them to bits!
records.en_auxiliary: All the more satisfying when I crush them to bits!
records.en: The higher something is piled,<CR>the better it sounds when it comes crashing down♪

records.jp: 放っておいて。<CR>あなたと戦う理由は、もうないから
records.en_original: Stop this. We have no reason to fight with you.
records.en_auxiliary: Stop this. We have no reason to fight with you.
records.en: Leave us alone.<CR>We have no reason to fight you anymore.

records.jp: そんなぁ、つれないこと言わないでくださいよぉ
records.en_original: Aww, don't say such terrible things!
records.en_auxiliary: Aww, don't say such terrible things!
records.en: Aww, don't be so cold.

records.jp: ……そうだ。じゃあ、<CR>お二人がとっても気になってることを教えてあげます
records.en_original: How about I tell you something that I'm sure you're dying to know!
records.en_auxiliary: How about I tell you something that I'm sure you're dying to know!
records.en: ...I know. Then I will tell you something<CR>you two are very eager to know.

records.jp: そしたら私にも興味を持ってくれますよね？
records.en_original: Will you humor me then?
records.en_auxiliary: Will you humor me then?
records.en: Then you will take an interest in me too, won't you?

records.jp: 何を言って……？
records.en_original: What could you possibly know that—
records.en_auxiliary: What could you possibly know that—
records.en: What are you talking about...?

records.jp: 私、あなたたちのお母さんが<CR>今どこにいるか、知ってますよ？
records.en_original: Even if it's about the location of your little ol' mom?
records.en_auxiliary: Even if it's about the location of your little ol' mom?
records.en: I know where your mother<CR>is right now, you know?

records.jp: なっ……！？<CR>なんであなたが、そんなことを……！？
records.en_original: What?! How could you know that...?
records.en_auxiliary: What?! How could you know that...?
records.en: What...?!<CR>How could you know that...?!

records.jp: 居場所を調べるなんて簡単です。<CR>私、神の力が使えますから♪
records.en_original: Finding a person is nothing when you have the power of a god.
records.en_auxiliary: Finding a person is nothing when you have the power of a god.
records.en: Finding someone's location is easy.<CR>After all, I can use the power of a god♪

records.jp: い、今の誰！？
records.en_original: Wh-who was that?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-who was that?!
records.en: Wh-who was that?!

records.jp: …………駒川詩ちゃん。私たちと敵対していた子だよ
records.en_original: Uta Komagawa. A girl who considered us enemies.
records.en_auxiliary: Uta Komagawa. A girl who considered us enemies.
records.en: ...Komagawa Uta-chan. A girl who was hostile to us.

records.jp: 駒川――
records.en_original: Komagawa...
records.en_auxiliary: Komagawa...
records.en: Komagawa...

records.jp: 詩ちゃん……！！
records.en_original: Uta?!
records.en_auxiliary: Uta?!
records.en: Uta-chan...!!

records.jp: 詩帆さん、こころ、知ってるの？
records.en_original: Shiho... Kokoro. You know her?
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho... Kokoro. You know her?
records.en: Shiho-san, Kokoro, do you know her?

records.jp: はい、今の言葉を聞いて思い出せました。<CR>全部ではないですが……
records.en_original: Yes. Hearing her name brought some memories back. It's not everything, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. Hearing her name brought some memories back. It's not everything, but...
records.en: Yes. Hearing those words brought some memories back.<CR>Not all of them, but...

records.jp: 駒川詩ちゃんは、すごく……危険な子なんだ
records.en_original: Uta Komagawa is a very dangerous girl.
records.en_auxiliary: Uta Komagawa is a very dangerous girl.
records.en: Komagawa Uta-chan is a very... dangerous girl.

records.jp: 危険……？
records.en_original: What do you mean, dangerous?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean, dangerous?
records.en: Dangerous...?

records.jp: 人を傷つけるのが楽しい。<CR>詩ちゃんは、そういう子なんだ……
records.en_original: She...enjoys inflicting pain on others.
records.en_auxiliary: She...enjoys inflicting pain on others.
records.en: Hurting people brings her pleasure.<CR>That is the kind of person Uta-chan is...

records.en_original: What...?
records.en_auxiliary: What...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: いえ、他人だけじゃないです。<CR>自分に向いた“痛み”にすら、彼女は歓喜してました
records.en_original: No, not just other people. She even enjoys pain inflicted on herself.
records.en_auxiliary: No, not just other people. She even enjoys pain inflicted on herself.
records.en: No, not only others.<CR>She even delighted in pain directed at herself.

records.jp: 人とは違う感性を持った子なんです
records.en_original: She doesn't feel things like the rest of us.
records.en_auxiliary: She doesn't feel things like the rest of us.
records.en: She has sensibilities unlike those of other people.

records.jp: な、なるほど……
records.en_original: W-wow...
records.en_auxiliary: W-wow...
records.en: I-I see...

records.jp: 詩ちゃんは、私たちにお母さんの居場所を伝えてきた
records.en_original: Uta knew where our mom went.
records.en_auxiliary: Uta knew where our mom went.
records.en: Uta-chan told us where our mother was.

records.jp: か、神の力って言ってたよね？<CR>単にブラフなのか、それとも……
records.en_original: She said something about having the power of a god, right? Does she really have something like that...?
records.en_auxiliary: She said something about having the power of a god, right? Does she really have something like that...?
records.en: She said she could use the power of a god, right?<CR>Was that merely a bluff, or...

records.jp: どちらだとしても、<CR>なんでわざわざそんなこと言ったんだろう？
records.en_original: Whatever the case, why would she bring up your mother unprovoked?
records.en_auxiliary: Whatever the case, why would she bring up your mother unprovoked?
records.en: Either way,<CR>why would she go out of her way to tell you?

records.jp: 何か、意図があるのかもしれないね……
records.en_original: Maybe she was planning something...
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe she was planning something...
records.en: She may have had some ulterior motive...

records.jp: ねえ……あそこ、誰かいない？
records.en_original: Hey... Isn't that a person over there?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey... Isn't that a person over there?
records.en: Hey... Isn't that a person over there?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: お姉ちゃん！
records.en_original: Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: Mio!
records.en: Onee-chan!

records.jp: こんなときに……！
records.en_original: C'mon demons, read the mood!
records.en_auxiliary: C'mon demons, read the mood!
records.en: At a time like this...!

records.jp: 邪魔しないで。<CR>私はもう、お姉ちゃんを一人にしないんだから！
records.en_original: Out of my way. I won't let my sister be alone any longer!
records.en_auxiliary: Out of my way. I won't let my sister be alone any longer!
records.en: Stay out of my way.<CR>I'm never leaving Onee-chan alone again!
